title: 18255 - 18255/P1847/006215
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fault Code / Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) stored in ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği Kontrol Modülü (J104)
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği Kontrol Modülü (J104) for Fault Codes
VCDS > Select > 03 - ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği > Fault Codes - 02
VCDS > Select > 03 - ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği > Fault Codes - 02
technicalNotes: A Fault Code stored in one Module may influence other Modules as well, if a Kontrol Modülü requires certain Information/Signals and the sending Module/Component is faulty it may store this Code.
